## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /hublytics/session-replay/v1/config` — Get session replay configuration.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /home/v2/api/{apiId}` — Read data for a specific API ID.
- `GET /ip-lookup` — Lookup IP information.
- `GET /v2/cf-location` — Get location information from Cloudflare.

### Data Write (5)
- `POST /api/cartographer/v1/rhumb` — Submit rhumb data.
- `POST /cartographer/v1/ipl` — Submit IP list data.
- `POST /frontend/observability/page-tracking/store/` — Store page tracking data.
- `POST /metrics/v1/frontend/custom/send` — Send custom frontend metrics.
- `POST /v2/activity/view` — Record an activity view.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to App Hubspot's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access App Hubspot data without official API access
- Automate actions on api.hubspot.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the App Hubspot frontend uses
